mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_resource (resource_no, parent_resource_no, resource_name, resource_type, request_path, label, data_state, sort_no, icon, create_time, create_by, remark) VALUES (#{resourceNo}, #{parentResourceNo}, #{resourceName}, #{resourceType}, #{requestPath}, #{label}, #{dataState}, #{sortNo}, #{icon}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT id, resource_no, parent_resource_no, resource_name, resource_type, request_path, label, data_state, sort_no, icon, create_time, update_time, remark, create_by, update_by FROM sys_resource ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, resource_no, parent_resource_no, resource_name, resource_type, request_path, label, data_state, sort_no, icon, create_time, update_time, remark, create_by, update_by FROM sys_resource WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, resource_no, parent_resource_no, resource_name, resource_type, request_path, label, data_state, sort_no, icon, create_time, update_time, remark, create_by, update_by FROM sys_resource WHERE resource_no = #{resourceNo}

SELECT id, resource_no, parent_resource_no, resource_name, resource_type, request_path, label, data_state, sort_no, icon, create_time, update_time, remark, create_by, update_by FROM sys_resource WHERE parent_resource_no = #{parentResourceNo}
